connector.name: Soma
connector.registryDescription: Drop-in RMCP runtime for provider-backed MCP tools, prompts, resources, and agent capabilities.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image soma:0.7.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.dinglebear, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOMA_HOME
env.description: Runtime data directory inside the Soma container.

env.name: SOMA_PROVIDER_DIR
env.description: Directory scanned for drop-in provider manifests and modules.

env.name: SOMA_API_URL
env.description: Optional deployed platform API or upstream API base URL used by the SomaClient compatibility layer. Leave unset for local provider/runtime mode.

env.name: SOMA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional bearer token or upstream API key for provider-backed calls that use SomaClient. Keep secret.

env.name: RUST_LOG
env.description: Rust tracing filter for local CLI and stdio MCP logs.

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.soma]
command = "docker"
args = ["run", "-i", "--rm", "ghcr.io/dinglebear-ai/soma:0.7.0", "mcp"]

[mcp_servers.soma.env]
SOMA_HOME = "/data"
SOMA_PROVIDER_DIR = "/data/providers"
SOMA_API_URL = "<soma-api-url>"
SOMA_API_KEY = "<your-soma-api-key>"
RUST_LOG = "info"
